item.title: UniTN at CCS 2026 and AISec 2026
item.description: Matteo Golinelli and Carlo Ramponi will travel to The Hague to present two accepted papers at ACM CCS 2026 and its colocated AISec workshop. Carlo will present N00B: Bounds Checking for the Masses , while Matteo will present AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination .

item.title: ACSAC 2026
item.description: We will be at ACSAC 2026 in Los Angeles, CA, USA, from December 7-11, 2026, to present When POST Becomes GET: Investigating HTTP Method Interchangeability and Its Security Implications .
